name: Solange
notes: Houston-to-New-Orleans art-soul, Saadiq-executive-produced, and the entry describes a record whose drums are the quietest thing in it: "minimal and dry — a small kit or drum machine placed low in the mix, kick on 1 with a single extra hit, snare or rim on 3 as often as on 2&4, no hat carpet, and long passages with no drums at all. Percussion is hand-played (congas, shaker, claps) and mixed forward." So the kick density is 1–3, the hat is non-continuous at a fill density of 0.1, the snare carries a cross-stick option, and the percussion gain sits at −1 dB — the only model in this batch whose percussion is louder than its kit. The band is the catalogue's own 73–125. Harmony is the stated parameter: "static modal beds with one moving inner voice, unresolved maj7/m9 sonorities held for 8+ bars, and horn voicings that supply the chord rather than a keyboard" — hence the long chord durations, the vamp-weighted harmonic rhythm, `maxChords` 3 and a horn timbre hint. Melody is "soft, breathy, mid-register, extremely low note-density — often 3–5 pitches per phrase", which is `motifPitchCount` 3–5 and density 2–4, and the counter is horn or synth, "never guitar". Bass "frequently enters late and functions as a hook", so it is an independent riff with plenty of rest rather than a kick mirror. ⚠ The INFERRED parameters are all drum values (the research marks its drum placement as inferred), the melody numbers and the countermelody density. ⚠ The half-time option the entry calls for is not encoded as a separate placement; the Lane line's straight 2&4 spine is what this model states. ⚠ **The countermelody reached 960/1000 distinct answers against a floor of 980 (2026-08-17, counter variety floor).** `melody.emptyBarBias` came down from 0.24 to 0.1. The counter's note count is `densityRatio` times the lead's own note count, so a bar the lead leaves empty is a bar the counter has nothing to answer — and one empty region is IDENTICAL to every other one, which is the single thing a seed cannot vary. Measured across this roster the models failing this gate average 0.150 here against 0.030 for the models that pass. ⚠ The value that moved here is INFERRED rather than a researched claim — the entry's Melody/chords line reads "Rhodes/synth pads, a brass section as the primary harmonic instrument, and Saadiq-lineage bass. Melody is soft, breathy, mid-register, extremely low note-density — often 3–5 pitches per phrase — with block-harmony stacks (4–8 identical layers) as the chorus device. Countermelody is horn or synth, never guitar.", and every claim in it still holds after the change.
